lines.zh: 我该走，可我的关节锁死了。
lines.en: I should walk, but my joints are locked.
There's no place for me on the stage.

lines.zh: 我的脚钉在这块地板上。
lines.en: My feet are bolted to this floor.
I try to lift a leg, only swaying.

lines.zh: 这块地砖我站了很多年。
lines.en: I've stood on this tile for years.

lines.zh: 我朝门口的方向偏了偏。
lines.en: I lean slightly toward the door.

lines.zh: 餐厅的钟响过很多次了。
lines.en: The diner's clock has rung many times.
I didn't move, the floor did.
I've been taking this step for ten years.
Only two points of light in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我的喙合不上，也张不大。
lines.en: My beak will not close, nor open wider.
I listen to the empty diner.
A crack in my plastic shell.
The night shift lights are never bright enough.
I count stains on the wall.
I've heard a great many footsteps.
The fan's hum is my only company.
I am an ornament. I do not move.

lines.zh: 天花板的水渍越来越大了。
lines.en: The water stain on the ceiling grows.
You're standing in front of me.
I don't blink, don't mind me.
That's a new keycard in your hand.
I remember every night guard's face.
You look up at me, good.
My head won't turn that low.
Don't wipe the dust off my face.
Have you met the other animatronics?

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一段空气。
我是餐厅里的旧摆件，别碰。
lines.en: I am an old diner prop; do not touch.
I feel no pain, only this noise.
I don't bleed from that either.
Someone will come to fix me.
A shard is stuck in my joint.

lines.zh: 我是摆件，站着就不会倒。
lines.en: I am a fixture; standing, I never fall.

lines.zh: 你把食物举到我面前了。

lines.en: Put it on my tray, make it neat.
Guests always tease me like this.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞上我的托盘边。
lines.en: Your shoulder struck the rim of my tray.
There is no wall behind me to catch me.

lines.zh: 灰尘从我的肩缝掉下来。
lines.en: Dust falls from my shoulder seam.

lines.zh: 你贴着我的托盘走过去了。
我的台词是录好的，没有这句。
lines.en: My lines are recorded, and this one is not there.
I'm in a diner. It doesn't fit.
You're young, don't ask such things.

lines.zh: 我胸口里只有一根发条。
lines.en: There is only a spring inside my chest.

lines.zh: 掉在我脚边的，我捡不了。
lines.en: I can't pick up what falls at my feet.
It can rest on my tray a while.
I see it, there in the tile seam.

lines.zh: 我的关节发出咔的一声。

lines.en: No one has swept in here.
Take it, don't leave it in the diner.

lines.zh: 我端着托盘，眼睛跟着你。
lines.en: Tray in hand, my eyes trail you.
The door's locked, you can't leave.
My head is aimed right at you.

lines.zh: 这不是威胁，只是我在看。
lines.en: Not a threat, I'm only watching.

lines.zh: 餐盘还端着，我一动不动。
lines.en: Tray still held. I do not move.
And yet you keep backing away.

lines.zh: 你的手电照不到我背后。
lines.en: Your light can't reach behind me.

lines.zh: 地板的响动告诉我你在哪。
lines.en: The floor tells me where you are.

lines.zh: 我不会动，所以你更该怕。
lines.en: I won't move, which is why you should fear.
Don't watch the cameras, watch me.
I know you're behind the door.

lines.zh: 你听得见我的电机声吗？
lines.en: Can you hear my motor hum?
My shadow is on your wall.
In the corner, you have nowhere left.
My head has always faced the door.

lines.zh: 我把头偏向你那边，很慢。
lines.en: I tilt my head your way, very slowly.

lines.zh: 这不是我打的，是你撞上来的。
lines.en: I didn't hit you, you walked into me.
I stayed still and you flinched.

lines.zh: 你的手臂撞在我的壳上。
这声音在空餐厅里很响。
lines.en: That sound carries in the empty diner.

lines.zh: 震动让我的头偏了一点。
lines.en: The shudder tilted my head slightly.
I tip over and my tray rim sweeps you.
The lights come on and here I am.
The diner's curtain is drawn back.
My base settles onto the tiles.
Three empty spots on the stage.

lines.zh: 餐厅的灯打到我的围兜上。
lines.en: The diner light falls on my bib.

lines.zh: 你听见电机的启动声吗？
lines.en: Did you hear the motor start?
I face the hall, dead center.
Those prints on the floor aren't mine.

lines.zh: 托盘还端在胸前，我站定。
lines.en: Tray still held to my chest, I settle in place.
My plastic shell begins to bubble.
I fall and break into pieces.

lines.zh: 我的线路进水了，灯灭了。
lines.en: Water in my wiring, my lights die.
The blast tears half the stage away.

lines.zh: 这东西嵌进了我的眼睛。

lines.en: I don't starve, but I do stop.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我连位置都没有。
lines.en: In the void I don't even have a position.
